selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: How did the sinful group respond to the signs that point to Allah’s oneness when they entered worldly life with moral responsibility?
questions.answer: They met those signs with disbelief and refusal.

questions.question: Why is that view presented as too low for a human being?
questions.answer: Because human beings were given special senses, feelings, and abilities for higher spiritual purposes.

questions.question: What was their response to the blessings they received?
questions.answer: They answered with ingratitude.

questions.question: What mistaken idea about life is challenged in the passage?
questions.answer: The idea that life is only for comfort, civilization, and pleasing physical desires.

questions.question: What is another purpose of the faculties in relation to Allah’s names?
questions.answer: They help a person experience the different ways Allah’s names appear in the world.

questions.question: Why does the passage mention subtle senses and orderly body systems?
questions.answer: To show that human beings are carefully made for important purposes, not just appetite.

questions.question: What happens to a person who fulfills these two main aims?
questions.answer: The person grows, becomes complete, and reaches true human character.

questions.question: What is the link between belief and the world around us in this passage?
questions.answer: The world contains signs that can lead a person to belief if they are noticed properly.

questions.question: Who is being described at the beginning of the passage?
questions.answer: The group made up of sinners and wicked people.

questions.question: What did they deny that made their crime especially serious?
questions.answer: They denied the manifestations of the divine names.

questions.question: Why is denying the manifestations of the divine names such a heavy offense?
questions.answer: Because those manifestations are spread through life and the world, so denying them means rejecting many signs of Allah.

questions.question: Why does the passage say they deserve endless punishment?
questions.answer: Because they rejected the manifestations of the divine names and committed a huge offense with the gifts they had been given.

questions.question: What is the first of the two main aims of these God-given abilities?
questions.answer: To make Allah’s blessings known to a person so that the person gives thanks and worships.

questions.question: What is another duty after becoming aware of Allah’s blessings?
questions.answer: To worship Him.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the finer human senses and feelings?
questions.answer: They are delicate and meaningful gifts, not tools made only for low desires.

questions.question: What kind of human being results from using these faculties correctly?
questions.answer: A mature and genuine human being.

questions.question: What cause-and-effect lesson is taught about human faculties?
questions.answer: If they are used rightly, they lead to gratitude and belief; if misused, they lead to serious wrongdoing.

questions.question: What false view of success in life is criticized in this passage?
questions.answer: Thinking success means only living comfortably and pleasing the body.

questions.question: How did the wicked group answer the signs pointing to tawhid?
questions.answer: They rejected them instead of accepting Allah’s oneness.

questions.question: Why does the passage describe their wrongdoing as extremely great even though their life is short?
questions.answer: Because they denied the divine names and misused the life and abilities given to them for higher purposes.

questions.question: After noticing those gifts, what should a person do?
questions.answer: Thank Allah and worship Him.

questions.question: What is the second main aim of the human faculties?
questions.answer: To notice the signs of Allah’s names in the world, experience them, and come to faith through that recognition.

questions.question: What is one purpose of the human faculties in relation to blessings?
questions.answer: They help a person notice the many gifts from Allah.

questions.question: What is the first main aim of the human faculties?
questions.answer: To recognize Allah’s blessings and respond with thanks and worship.

title: Warning to the Wicked and the Self Misuse of Human Faculties and Their Two Main Purposes
